EmailTemplate.description: Generic response sent to all new leads
EmailTemplate.name: Lead Auto Response
EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for completing the Red Cross Blood Drive interest form!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Lead.FirstName} {!Lead.LastName},
Thank you for expressing interest in becoming an American Red Cross blood drive partner. A representative in your area will contact you soon regarding next steps. As this time, you may experience a delay in response time due to the resounding response we have received to our recent ask. We appreciate your patience!
In the meantime, we invite you to visit RedCross.org to learn about even more ways you can get involved. We look forward to our potential partnership!
Your American Red Cross
